purpose: Resolve exact native target overwrites, membrane/environment regulator locations, channel voltage/floor expressions and dispatch before composition

additional_bodies: normal/fast simulator molecule/GRN dispatch if blocks
native_source.hooks: Probe channel core records init/run and supplies prescribed P. Electroflux/update_Co/conductivity hooks record DChan and produce no transport/current. No gate, flux, tissue or full simulator equivalence is claimed.

semantics.generator: read_modulators compiles expressions; no write_modulators exists in pinned source
semantics.factor: max effect * alpha; signed finite values retained, no [0,1] clamp
semantics.GJ_NaK: mem_concs or mapped env_concs; assign entire membrane factor, last writer wins
semantics.TJ: env regulators sample own env; cell regulators become literal 1 including positive direct-inhibitor 1; assign selected global TJ sites/all or one ion row
semantics.init: Modulator init resets *_block_o to ones, does not reset live GJ/NaK factors or allocate TJ_modulator
semantics.channel_star: Km *= exp(sign*z*Vm*F/(R*p.T)), sign + for env and - for membrane; p.T differs from sim.T
semantics.activation: Frozen native product of regular Hills plus sum of independent ! Hills, baseline1 when independent-only; signed direct & sum multiplies it
semantics.channel_activator_max: Ignored by actual native activator loop
semantics.channel_inhibitor_max: Streaming source sum-of-products from unparenthesized additions; NOT product of shifted Hills
semantics.channel_init: INIT skips exactly init_active is False; SIM runs all configured channels
semantics.channel_targets: Carried to core init, do not mask alpha; express selects all targets and scales channelMax after maxDm was already assigned
semantics.channel_diffusivity: After assigning core.modulator and core.run: DChan = core.P * rel_perm * maxDm * moddy; preserve possible modulator dependence already inside core.P
semantics.order: Native normal/fast paths run molecule channels then modulators then local network, followed by GRN channels/modulators/network; earlier pump/GJ/ECM consumers may use previous factors

units.samples_Km: mM, native membrane samples distinct from cell averages
units.controls: Native numeric multiplier convention; raw direct mM terms are not a dimensional derivation
units.DChan: m2/s in diffusion dispatch, despite max conductivity input label; no automatic unit conversion

domain.parameters: Finite signed max effects/floors, positive Km/Hill powers/F/R/T, nonnegative maxDm
domain.layout: Explicit nonempty membrane/environment/ion axes, global boolean TJ target mask, unique names per dictionary, neutral rule padding
domain.rejection: Malformed lists/zones, unsupported target/ion/class, broken direct ordering and only-direct groups, incompatible shapes or nonfinite factors

reference: Independent stdlib 80-digit Decimal scalar source arithmetic and ordered target loops
scope_limits: No channel isoform construction or core dynamics in production component
No physical transport/current, ATP, heat, energy or tissue-parity inference
Caller owns phase/clock, prior controls, events, target masks, channel P, species amount inventories and checkpoint identity
Native dispatch probes replace physical core/transport only with explicitly recorded test doubles
